messages:
emma: Quick postmortem follow-up: we still need firm owners and short timelines for the GPU capacity/autoscale remediation items (quota, scheduler tuning, headroom). Can we lock this in now?

li: I can take scheduler tuning (packing heuristics + preempt threshold). Plan: propose config diff by Tue, run 36h A/B canary Wed-Thu.

omar: I'll own quota and finance coordination. Proposal: provisional headroom = 20% until sims complete. Need to know if we can target by GPU family or only org-level.

tess: I'll manage tracker + alerts. Added a row in tracker: https://go.redwood/incident-2005 (owner, due, verification).

emma: omar, can you confirm scope (family vs org) today EOD?

omar: short answer: per-family scoping is possible but procurement billing remains at org-level. For 20% reserved increases we'll need a one-off approval if >10%. I'll open request.

ops-bot: [automated] Created task INC-2005-01: Scheduler config draft (owner=li) due=2026-04-07.

prod-bot: [automated] Created task INC-2005-02: Headroom simulation (owner=li, assignee=omar) due=2026-04-09.

li: scheduler snippet (first pass). Will post full diff in tracker and include fail-fast checks.

```
# scheduler config snippet
binpackWeight: 1.1
preemption:
  enabled: true
  thresholdPct: 60
maxPodBurst: 12
```

tess: test plan added: canary groups in us-west-2 and eu-central. We'll fail-fast if p999 increases > 12% or tail-utilization > 80% for 30m.

omar: for headroom sims, I want p50/p95/p99/p999 and cost delta (GPU-hours). Can you also produce zone-level heatmaps?

li: yep. will tag outputs by zone and GPU family.

emma: ownership roundup: li = scheduler tuning & canary, omar = quota + finance, tess = tracker+alerts+runbooks. Deadlines: li Tue config, canary Wed-Thu, omar confirm procurement path EOD, tess add PD rule + dashboard.

ops-bot: [automated] Created PagerDuty rule PD-1204: tail-utilization > 78% for 45m. Assigned to oncall.

tess: added dashboard panel for p999 latency by zone and GPU family. Also linked rollback runbook in tracker and assigned rollback owner for canary window.

omar: finance OK for short-term burst credits for tests. Formal reserved commit after two successful validations and cost projection.

li: remember to validate emergency drain during canary. I'll coordinate with oncall to run a dry-run before the canary.

emma: schedule a 30m pre-canary dry-run. Who can run it?

tess: ops-bot scheduled dry-run -> 2026-04-08 14:00 UTC. ops-bot: task INC-2005-03 created.

ops-bot: [automated reminder] Dry-run scheduled: Emergency drain validation -> 2026-04-08 14:00 UTC. Reminder 15m prior.

li: noted. small acceptance criteria: scheduler changes must reduce p999 by >=10% in canary without increasing aggregate GPU-hours >8%.

omar: I'll surface cost delta as a concise $$ estimate in the tracker after the sims.

emma: any blockers?

li: need a staging cluster with same GPU families & drivers. tess, can you request cluster now?

tess: opened CL ticket CL-459. ETA 8h to have kubeconfig in tracker.

emma: thanks. reconvene Fri 09:30 if we have canary data, otherwise async updates in the tracker.

prod-bot: [automated] Meeting scheduled: Autoscale remediation check-in -> 2026-04-10 09:30 UTC. Reminder 30m before.
